_comment: Was a REF effect handed a 'target'. DESTROY_REF/BANISH_REF act on get_ref(ref), the handler does not read 'target', and no earlier effect in the ability sets a ref -- so it aimed at no object and returned. The card destroys ITSELF, which DESTROY_PERMANENT does directly -- destroy() resolves the card's own zone. TWO PRINTED CLAUSES WERE SILENTLY DROPPED: '+3{p} and you may play it this turn' was nested inside the CREATE_TOKEN node under an `effects` key, and CREATE_TOKEN reads token/count/player/destination/counters and nothing else -- so neither half ran. GRANT_PLAY_FROM_BANISHED already does both (it takes a ref and a power_mod); CREATE_TOKEN now records what it made so the next effect can name it. Per the release notes the +3 is turn-scoped: 'if you do not play Crouching Tiger the turn it was created, it remains in the banished zone and loses the +3/2/1{p} effect.'
